result.description:
JBS Australia is the largest and most respected meat and food producer in Australia. We have a strong portfolio of leading and renowned beef, lamb, pork, salmon and value-added branded products, such as AMH, Swift, Primo, Murray Valley and Huon. JBS Australia is a part of the global JBS business, the largest animal protein business in the world, and the second largest food company, with operations in North America, South America, Europe, Australia and New Zealand.

The JBS Dinmore Processing Plant is the largest beef facility in the southern hemisphere. Located near Ipswich, in south east Queensland, the facility has a daily production ability of 3,400 cattle and employs approximately 2,600 people. Cattle are sourced from the finest cattle producing regions to produce a diverse range of pasture fed and grain beef products, from commodity to premium. The renowned AMH brand, the award-winning Yardstick, the highly marbled grain fed Pure Prime and our state’s brand, Queenslander Beef and more are all produced at Dinmore.

About the Role:
We are currently seeking a Mechanical Engineering Technician to join our Dinmore Plant. We are seeking a passionate and energetic individual who is committed to the position and providing an effective professional service. This is a fantastic opportunity to join our dynamic, exciting organization who are the leaders in safety and culture across Australia. Within the role you will enjoy the benefits and satisfaction in contributing to the continued growth and success of our business. This role will be responsible for providing maintenance support to all areas across the plant to ensure the attainment of Production, Quality/FSQA, and Workplace Health and Safety requirements and objectives. This is a full-time position with the annual salary more than $79,423 plus superannuation.

Your key responsibilities will include:
Conducts tests of mechanical systems, collects and analyses data, and assembles and installs mechanical assemblies in support of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists.
Ensuring maximum equipment uptime is achieved by providing effective and efficient mechanical preventative and breakdown maintenance
Engaging in fabrication, installation and repair of mechanical machines, instruments or appliances
Ensuring that all work is carried out to the Company and requirements and conforms to all relevant regulations
Utilising fault-finding to troubleshoot and rectify problems

About you
Previous experience in a fast-paced industrial manufacturing environment
Previous experience within the meat industry advantageous
Sound knowledge of pneumatics and hydraulics, as well as a basic knowledge of electrics and welding skills
Excellent interpersonal skills
Demonstrated continuous improvement approach
Ability to support a broad variety of mechanical work
High level of accuracy and attention to detail
Ability to communicate at all levels
Ability to work autonomously as well as in a team environment
Ability to work various shifts
Full Australian working rights

Why work for us:
Retail discounts with national partners
Health insurance discounts on Bupa Health and Medibank
Heavily discounted meat products

The ad is valid for 28 days.

What next? If you’re passionate and want to be a part of the largest meat, pork and salmon manufacturer and producer in Australia, this opportunity may be for you. Apply now!

result.description:
Join a high-performing engineering team delivering complex, cutting-edge defence programmes   
  Brisbane | 12-Month Contract | Highly Attractive Daily Rates  
   
 An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Senior Project Engineer to join a leading global defence organisation supporting a significant land systems program. Working within a multidisciplinary engineering environment, you will play a key role in the delivery of complex capability projects from concept through to production and integration.   This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys balancing technical design responsibilities with project delivery, stakeholder engagement, and engineering governance. 
       
  Your new role  
   
 As a Senior Project Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting the planning, coordination and delivery of engineering activities across a complex defence program. You will work closely with design, systems, manufacturing and project management teams to ensure technical outcomes are delivered on time, within budget and to the required standards. 
   
 A key part of this role will involve the development and management of engineering designs and documentation using Creo or CAD and associated product lifecycle management tools.     Key Responsibilities  
   
 
 Coordinate engineering activities across the project lifecycle. 
 Support project planning, scheduling and technical risk management. 
 Develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies and engineering documentation. 
 Create and maintain 3D CAD models and technical drawings using Creo or CAD. 
 Manage engineering change processes and design modifications. 
 Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure project objectives are achieved. 
 Support design reviews, verification and validation activities. 
 Ensure compliance with defence, quality and engineering standards. 
 Collaborate with manufacturing and production teams to support successful delivery outcomes. 
 
   
   
  What you'll need to succeed  
   
 
 Degree qualified in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or a related discipline. 
 Demonstrated experience working as a Project Engineer within defence, aerospace, heavy vehicle, manufacturing or other complex engineering environments. 
 Strong mechanical design experience. 
 Strong experience using PTC Creo or CAD for 3D modelling and design activities. 
 Experience producing and managing engineering drawings, BOMs and technical documentation. 
 Exposure to PLM systems such as Windchill would be highly regarded. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills. 
 Ability to work within multidisciplinary engineering teams and manage competing priorities. 
 
   
  What you'll get in return  
   
 
 Long-term contract opportunity with strong likelihood of extension 
 Highly competitive daily rates 
 Opportunity to work on a nationally significant defence capability program. 
 Brisbane (Eagle Farm) location with a flexible and collaborative team environment. 
 Exposure to advanced engineering and cutting-edge defence technologies. 
 
  *Australian Citizenship is mandatory*   
  What you need to do now  
   
 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to  lauryn.reddick@hays.com.au  
   
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career. 
    Please  click here  to apply.
